item.name: Cloth Robes
item.description: Simple woven garments offering minimal protection.

item.name: Padded Armor
item.description: Quilted layers of cloth stuffed with wool or scrap.

item.name: Leather Jerkin
item.description: Hardened leather chestpiece, light and flexible.

item.name: Studded Leather
item.description: Leather armor reinforced with close-set metal studs.

item.name: Hide Armor
item.description: Crude armor made from thick animal hides.

item.name: Chain Shirt
item.description: A shirt made of interlocking metal rings.

item.name: Scale Mail
item.description: A coat and leggings covered with overlapping metal scales.

breastplate.n.01.definition: armor plate that protects the chest; the front part of a cuirass

item.name: Breastplate
item.description: A solid metal plate that protects the front of the torso.

item.name: Half Plate
item.description: A combination of plate and chain, covering most of the body.

item.name: Full Plate
item.description: A complete suit of interlocking metal plates.

item.name: Ring Mail
item.description: Leather armor with metal rings sewn into it.

item.name: Splint Mail
item.description: Armor made of narrow vertical strips of metal riveted to a leather backing.

item.name: Banded Mail
item.description: Overlapping horizontal bands of steel laminated to leather.

item.name: Mithril Chain Shirt
item.description: A shirt of incredibly light and strong mithril rings.

item.name: Mithril Breastplate
item.description: A breastplate of shimmering mithril, strong as steel but feather-light.

item.name: Mithril Full Plate
item.description: A masterpiece of smithing, offering incredible protection with minimal weight.

item.name: Shield, Buckler
item.description: A small, fist-gripped shield for parrying.

item.name: Shield, Light Steel
item.description: A round or kite shield made of steel, offering good protection.

item.name: Shield, Tower
item.description: A massive shield that can provide cover.

item.name: Helmet, Open
item.description: A simple metal cap that protects the top of the head.

item.name: Helmet, Great Helm
item.description: A full helmet enclosing the entire head, with a narrow visor.

item.name: Gauntlets, Leather
item.description: Reinforced leather gloves.

item.name: Gauntlets, Plate
item.description: Metallic gloves with articulated plates.

greaves.n.01.definition: the residue that remains after animal fat has been rendered

item.name: Greaves
item.description: Plate armor designed to protect the shins.

item.name: Pauldrons
item.description: Armor plates that protect the shoulders.

item.name: Mask of the Silent
item.description: A magically silenced mask that muffles the wearer's breath and speech.

item.name: Spider Silk Cloak
item.description: A cloak woven from the silk of giant phase spiders, offering surprising resistance.

item.name: Wyvern Hide Vest
item.description: Tough leather from a wyvern, resistant to piercing attacks.

item.name: Boneweave Armor
item.description: Armor crafted from the bones and sinews of monstrous creatures.

item.name: Dragonscale Mail
item.description: Legendary armor crafted from the scales of an ancient dragon. Resists the dragon's element.

item.name: Glimmerwood Shield
item.description: A shield made from wood that absorbs magic, granting resistance to spells.

item.name: Obsidian Plate
item.description: Brittle but incredibly hard armor formed from volcanic glass. Weak to bludgeoning.

item.name: Crystal Shard Armor
item.description: Armor made from living crystal that can refract light-based attacks.

item.name: Dwarven Stoneplate
item.description: Extremely heavy armor carved from a single block of enchanted mountain granite.

item.name: Elven Leafweave
item.description: Armor that seems grown rather than made, offering stealth and protection.

brigandine.n.01.definition: a medieval coat of chain mail consisting of metal rings sewn onto leather or cloth

item.name: Brigandine
item.description: Cloth or leather armor with steel plates riveted to the inside.

cuirass.n.01.definition: medieval body armor that covers the chest and back

item.name: Cuirass
item.description: A breastplate and backplate fastened together.

gorget.n.01.definition: armor plate that protects the neck

item.name: Gorget
item.description: A steel collar to protect the neck.

vambrace.n.01.definition: cannon of plate armor protecting the forearm

item.name: Vambraces
item.description: Forearm guards.

item.name: Chausses
item.description: Plate armor for the legs.

solleret.n.01.definition: armor plate that protects the foot; consists of mail with a solid toe and heel

item.name: Sabatons
item.description: Armored shoes covering the top of the foot.

item.name: Shadow Drapery
item.description: A cloak woven from tangible shadows, granting near-invisibility in darkness.

item.name: Celestial Aegis
item.description: A brilliant breastplate forged from a fallen star, radiating holy power.

item.name: Abyssal Carapace
item.description: Armor fashioned from the chitinous plates of a demon, resistant to fire and fear.

item.name: Living Ivy Wrap
item.description: Constantly growing ivy that hardens on impact. Regenerates over time.

item.name: Frostfell Mantle
item.description: A mantle of ice that never melts, granting immunity to cold and vulnerability to fire.

item.name: Molten Core Harness
item.description: Harness of cooled volcanic rock, glowing with internal heat. Immune to fire.

item.name: Puzzleplate
item.description: Armor made of interlocking adamantine plates that can be rearranged for different defenses.

item.name: Whisperweave Garb
item.description: Armor that allows the wearer to briefly become ethereal.

item.name: Trollhide Jerkin
item.description: Tough hide that slowly knits itself back together when damaged.

item.name: Gorgon Hide Shield
item.description: A heavy shield that can temporarily petrify attackers who strike it.

item.name: Stormrider's Cuirass
item.description: Armor that crackles with lightning, shocking nearby foes.

item.name: Lichebone Armor
item.description: Bone armor from a powerful lich, granting resistance to necrotic energy.

item.name: Kraken Leather
item.description: Slick, water-resistant leather that grants freedom of movement underwater.

item.name: Sunforged Plate
item.description: Plate armor blessed by a sun god, dealing radiant damage to undead attackers.

item.name: Runic Warding Bands
item.description: Bracelets etched with runes that can absorb a magical attack before shattering.

item.name: Doomplate
item.description: Armor forged in the heart of a dying star. Exudes an aura of dread.

item.name: Phoenix Down Cloak
item.description: A cloak that allows the wearer to rise from death once, consumed in the process.

item.name: Mage's Aetherial Robes
item.description: Robes that enhance magical power but offer little physical protection.

item.name: Sentinel's Ward
item.description: An amulet that creates a temporary forcefield against projectiles.

item.name: Platemail of the Juggernaut
item.description: Extremely heavy armor that allows the wearer to crash through obstacles.

item.name: Ghostwalker's Shroud
item.description: A shroud that allows the wearer to pass through solid objects for a short time.

item.name: Serpent Scale Armor
item.description: Scaly armor that grants resistance to poison.

item.name: Barbarian's Hide
item.description: A simple, rugged hide favored by northern tribes.

item.name: Assassin's Guild Leathers
item.description: Supple, silent leather armor with hidden pockets for tools.

item.name: Knight's Tabard
item.description: A cloth surcoat worn over armor, displaying a knight's heraldry.

item.name: Warlock's Cryptarmor
item.description: Armor fused from the remains of a patron's previous champions.

item.name: Dragonbone Mail
item.description: Armor crafted from the bones of a dragon, humming with residual power.

item.name: Final Bastion
item.description: The ultimate armor, said to be worn by the gods themselves. Nearly impenetrable.

item.name: Peasant's Sling
item.description: A simple, braided sling used by herders and the poorest of militia. Effective only in the most desperate of situations.

item.name: Bone Shortbow
item.description: Crafted from the rib of a great beast and strung with its tendons. A primitive but reliable weapon.

item.name: Ironwood Recurve
item.description: A finely crafted bow from the heartwood of an ironwood tree, granting it superior power and resilience.

item.name: Gnome-engineered Hand Crossbow
item.description: A compact, clockwork crossbow with a magazine for five bolts. Favored by rogues and artisans.

item.name: Elven Hunting Longbow
item.description: A bow of elegant and impossible grace, seemingly grown rather than made. Silent and deadly in the right hands.

item.name: Dwarven Heavy Repeater
item.description: A massive, crank-operated crossbow that fires heavy bolts at a frightening rate. Requires a strong arm to wield effectively.

item.name: Titanstring Bow
item.description: A legendary bow strung with the sinew of a titan. It draws upon the wielder's strength, firing arrows with earth-shattering force.

item.name: Goblin Toss-Knife
item.description: A crudely sharpened piece of scrap metal, balanced for throwing. As likely to injure the thrower as the target.

item.name: Windlass Crossbow
item.description: A powerful crossbow requiring a windlass to cock. Slow to load, but packs a tremendous punch.

item.name: Shadow-Woven Shortbow
item.description: Forged in the Shadowfell, this bow's arrows seem to drink the light around them, making them near-impossible to dodge.

blunderbuss.n.01.definition: a short musket of wide bore with a flared muzzle

item.name: Blunderbuss
item.description: A loud, messy firearm that fires a spray of shrapnel. Devastating at close range but highly inaccurate.

item.name: Boomerang of Returning
item.description: A masterfully carved wooden boomerang that magically returns to the thrower's hand, provided it doesn't hit a target.

item.name: Javelin of Lightning
item.description: When thrown, this javelin transforms into a line of lightning, striking the first target in its path.

item.name: Thorn Whip
item.description: A druidic weapon, a living vine that can strike at a distance and entangle foes.

arquebus.n.01.definition: an obsolete firearm with a long barrel

item.name: Arquebus
item.description: An early, long-barreled firearm. Powerful and armor-piercing, but prone to misfires and requires a forked stand to aim.

item.name: Sunstone Sling
item.description: A sling of gilded leather that fires sunstone pellets. Its projectiles glow with radiant energy, harmful to the undead.

item.name: Orcish Skull-Launcher
item.description: A brutal contraption that hurls spiked skulls or similarly sized rocks. More terrifying than accurate.

item.name: Wyvern-Fang Blowgun
item.description: A blowgun crafted from a hollowed wyvern fang. Often used to deliver potent toxins.

item.name: Hooked Net
item.description: A weighted net used to entangle and trip opponents, rather than cause direct injury.

item.name: Crystal Shard Launcher
item.description: An arcane focus that fires concentrated shards of pure force.

item.name: Ballista Bolt (Siege)
item.description: A massive bolt meant for a ballista. Not a wieldable weapon, but a munition for siege engines.

item.name: Fey-Twisted Branch
item.description: A branch from the Feywild that never runs out of magical thorns to fire. Its shots can cause confusion or sleep.

item.name: Repeating Hand Crossbow
item.description: A sophisticated hand crossbow with a top-mounted 6-bolt magazine, allowing for rapid fire.

item.name: Flametongue Longbow
item.description: Arrows nocked on this bow burst into magical flame, dealing severe fire damage on impact.

item.name: Gnomish Acid Sprinkler
item.description: A device that sprays a cone of corrosive acid. Short-ranged and requires careful handling.

item.name: Drow Poison Needle-Shooter
item.description: A delicate, wrist-mounted device that silently fires needles coated in paralytic drow poison.

item.name: Giant's Throwing Boulder
item.description: A favorite projectile of hill and stone giants. Not a weapon to be carried, but certainly to be avoided.

item.name: Whisper-Fletched Arrow (Ammo)
item.description: Special arrows that make no sound in flight. They confer their silent property to the bow that fires them.

item.name: Spectral Longbow
item.description: A bow formed from the essence of the Ethereal Plane. Its arrows can strike ethereal creatures and phase through minor barriers.

item.name: Halfling Soup-Can Launcher
item.description: A quirky slingshot-like weapon built to fire heavy cans or stones with surprising force. A halfling innovation.

item.name: Mithril-Hafted Javelin
item.description: A javelin so perfectly balanced and light it can be thrown with pinpoint accuracy over incredible distances.

item.name: Onyx Panther Shortbow
item.description: A bow as black as midnight, carved in the likeness of a stalking panther. Grants the wielder enhanced night vision.

item.name: Arcane Blast-Rod
item.description: A fundamental wizard's weapon, channeling raw magical energy into a destructive bolt. Scales with the user's power.

item.name: Serpentine Bow
item.description: A bow wrapped in the scales of a giant constrictor snake. Arrows fired from it have a chance to poison the target.

item.name: Gravity Cannon
item.description: An experimental dwarven cannon that uses gravitational fields to launch solid metal spheres at hypersonic speeds.

item.name: Auran Wind-Bow
item.description: A bow made by air elementals. It creates its own arrows from solidified wind and never needs ammunition.

item.name: Trebuchet (Siege)
item.description: The superior siege engine. Hurls massive stones or incendiary payloads over castle walls. A stationary weapon.

item.name: Chakram
item.description: A sharp, circular throwing blade. Skilled users can make it ricochet off surfaces.

item.name: Dragonbone Greatbow
item.description: A bow of immense power, crafted from the bones and sinew of an ancient dragon. Imbues arrows with elemental energy.

item.name: Wand of Magic Missiles
item.description: A classic arcane focus that projects unerring bolts of force. Damage is consistent but not overwhelming.

item.name: Barbed Sling Bullet (Ammo)
item.description: Lead bullets with cruel barbs designed to cause bleeding wounds and be difficult to remove.

item.name: Starfall Longbow
item.description: Forged from a meteorite, this bow fires arrows that gleam like falling stars, dealing radiant damage and blinding foes.

item.name: Gnomish Shocker
item.description: A handheld device that launches a pair of conductive darts connected by a wire, delivering a powerful electric shock.

item.name: Molotov Cocktail
item.description: An improvised incendiary weapon. The initial impact is less dangerous than the spreading fire that follows.

item.name: Harp of Sonic Shards
item.description: A bardic instrument that, when played, fires projectiles of solidified sound.

item.name: Phase-Lock Crossbow
item.description: This crossbow's bolts ignore conventional armor, phasing through it to strike the target's true form beneath.

item.name: Shrieker Dart
item.description: A dart with a specially designed head that emits a piercing shriek in flight, disorienting the target.

item.name: Living Longbow
item.description: A bow that is a symbiotic creature. It can adjust its draw weight and even guide arrows slightly towards their target.

item.name: Explosive Bolt (Ammo)
item.description: A crossbow bolt with an alchemical charge in its head. Explodes on impact, dealing area damage.

item.name: Griffon Rider's Lance
item.description: A long, aerodynamic lance designed to be dropped from a great height onto targets below.

item.name: Blightwood Blowgun
item.description: A blowgun carved from wood corrupted by necrotic energy. Its darts inflict a rotting disease.

item.name: Orcish Throw-Axe
item.description: A heavy, unbalanced axe designed for one thing: being hurled with overwhelming force at an enemy's face.

item.name: Crystal Spire Longbow
item.description: A bow of breathtaking beauty, carved from a single giant crystal. It focuses sunlight into devastating laser-like arrows.

item.name: Netherium Repeater
item.description: A weapon from the lower planes, this crossbow fires bolts that siphon the life force of those they strike.

bolo_tie.n.01.definition: a cord fastened around the neck with an ornamental clasp and worn as a necktie

item.name: Bola
item.description: Weights connected by cords, thrown to entangle an enemy's legs and bring them to the ground.

item.name: Gravity Hammer
item.description: A massive hammer that, when thrown, creates a localized gravity well upon impact, crushing armor and bone.

item.name: Wasp-Nest-on-a-Stick
item.description: The lowest form of ranged weaponry. Throw it and run. The damage comes from the ensuing swarm of angry insects.

item.name: Spectral Dagger
item.description: A dagger that can be magically summoned back to the hand after being thrown. A favorite of spellblades.

item.name: Flame-Belcher
item.description: A primitive, dragon-like flamethrower that spews a cone of burning alchemical gel.

item.name: Heartseeker Bow
item.description: A bow that guides its arrows unerringly to the most vulnerable spot on a target, often bypassing armor entirely.

item.name: Anchor Hook Launcher
item.description: Fires a grappling hook on a chain. Can be used to pull objects, enemies, or for cinematic swinging.

item.name: Thunderstone
item.description: A alchemically-treated stone that creates a deafening thunderclap when it strikes a hard surface.

item.name: Void-Touched Shortbow
item.description: A bow that seems to absorb light and sound. Its arrows create small voids upon impact, dealing force and necrotic damage.

item.name: Gnomish Pocket Catapult
item.description: A folding, spring-loaded mini-catapult perfect for launching caltrops, alchemical pellets, or small rocks.

item.name: Quill of the Storyteller
item.description: A mythical artifact. It does not deal physical damage, but can 'write' events into reality, making it the most potent ranged weapon of all.

item.name: Stone Ward
item.description: A quick stone barrier that grants a modest increase in armor.

item.name: Earthen Guard
item.description: Rough earth forms a protective shield, slightly raising armor.

item.name: Rock Shield
item.description: Dense rock encases the caster, offering nearâ€‘spectral defense.

item.name: Boulder Barrier
item.description: A temporary boulder forms a sturdy wall around the caster.

item.name: Titanic Brace
item.description: A massive stone frame that significantly raises armor.

item.name: Quake Shield

item.name: Golem's Grasp
item.description: The caster summons a golem's strength, sealing their defenses.

item.name: Granite Cloak
item.description: A cloak of granite that enhances the caster's defense.

item.name: Stoneform
item.description: The caster's body hardens to stone, bolstering armor.

item.name: Terra Fortress
item.description: A fortified stone fortress materializes around the caster.

item.name: Lithic Barrier
item.description: A layered stone barrier gives a substantial armor boost.

item.name: Ethereal Rock
item.description: An otherworldly stone cloud envelops the caster, offering defense.

item.name: Enduring Bedrock
item.description: An indestructible bedrock forms around the caster, staving off damage.

item.name: Stone Shield
item.description: A shimmering stone shield rises, augmenting armor.

item.name: Materialized Armor
item.description: Reality warps to manifest a protective stone armor.

item.name: Rockskin
item.description: The caster's skin turns to stone, providing a robust defensive layer.

item.name: Gale Guard
item.description: A swift gust surrounds the caster, creating a subtle air shield.

item.name: Zephyr Shield
item.description: A gentle zephyr enhances the caster's reflexes, raising evasion.

item.name: Wind Ward
item.description: A steady wind gust boosting the caster's nimbleness.

item.name: Breeze Barrier
item.description: A light breeze clears the air, boosting the caster's speed.

item.name: Storm Barrier
item.description: Storm winds gather to form a temporary airborne defense.

item.name: Air Shield
item.description: A swirling vortex increases the caster's agility.

item.name: Cyclone Shield
item.description: Cyclone winds encircle the caster, forming a temporary shield.

item.name: Tempest Guard
item.description: A fierce tempest grants the caster slight damage resistance.

item.name: Hurricane Halo
item.description: A hurricane forms an invisible halo, protecting the caster from attacks.

item.name: Aerial Armor
item.description: The air condenses into a lightweight armor around the caster.

item.name: Sirocco Strength
item.description: A hot Sirocco wind raises the caster's defensive capabilities.

item.name: Arctic Shield
item.description: Cold winds form an icy shield, denying damage to the caster.

item.name: Breeze Spell
item.description: A soothing breeze gives the caster an extra dodge.

item.name: Storm Aura
item.description: Storms swirl above, creating an aura of protection.

item.name: Air Bastion
item.description: A sturdy veil of air forms a bastion, raising defense.

item.name: Flame Ward
item.description: A flurry of embers forms a quick fire shield.

item.name: Fire Shield
item.description: Heat raises the caster's armor, providing moderate protection.

item.name: Heat Barrier
item.description: A wall of heat deflects incoming damage.

item.name: Molten Armor
item.description: Molten lava hardens around the caster, adding armor.

item.name: Ember Guard
item.description: Embers swirl in a protective guard.

item.name: Inferno Shield
item.description: A searing inferno boosts the caster's armor.

item.name: Blazing Bastion
item.description: A blazing bastion deflects attacks with scorching heat.

item.name: Cinder Shield
item.description: Cinders form a barrier, adding modest armor.

item.name: Pyroclasmic Shield
item.description: A volcanic shield erupts, providing fierce protection.

item.name: Scorch Armor
item.description: Scorching heat wraps the caster, granting extra armor.

item.name: Kindling Shield
item.description: Kindling sparks create a light defensive field.

item.name: Flare Protection
item.description: A flare of light bolsters the caster's resilience.

item.name: Firewall
item.description: A thick fireplace barrier blocks incoming blows.

item.name: Heatwave Cloak
item.description: Heatwaves cloak the caster, raising defense.

item.name: Lava Barrier
item.description: Molten lava forms a barrier of scorching fire.

item.name: Infernal Armor
item.description: Infernal flames coat the caster, delivering powerful armor boost.

item.name: Aqua Shield
item.description: A ring of water surrounds the caster, deflecting attacks.

item.name: Healing Waters
item.description: Gentle waters flow through the caster, restoring health.

item.name: Purifying Rain
item.description: A cleansing rain washes away poison.

item.name: Mending Mist
item.description: A mist of renewal heals the caster's wounds.

item.name: Cleanse Stream
item.description: A steady stream cures sickness.

item.name: Water Form
item.description: The caster's form becomes water, raising defense.

item.name: Healing Wave
item.description: A wave of healing washes over the caster, restoring health.

item.name: Blessing of the Tides
item.description: Blessings from the sea enhance the caster's attributes.

item.name: Fountain Shield
item.description: A fountain erupts to shield the caster.

item.name: Saline Sickness Cure
item.description: Saline waters purge poisons.

item.name: River of Restoration
item.description: A river flows through the caster, mending wounds.

item.name: Aquatic Aura
item.description: An aura of water surrounds, deflecting attacks.

item.name: Purifying Surge
item.description: A surge cleanses disease from the caster.

item.name: Flowing Healing
item.description: Flowing waters restore the caster's vitality.

item.name: Watershield
item.description: A steady watershield protects against attacks.

item.name: Essence of Life
item.description: Life itself flows into the caster, bringing powerful healing.
